newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand's 1996/1997 cane buying price unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Thailand's 1996/1997 cane buying price unchanged.

text.p: Thailand's economic ministers on Monday approved a proposal to set the price for mill purchases of sugar cane in the 1996/1997 (November-October) from growers at 500 baht per tonne, unchanged from last year's level.
The price, proposed by the Cane and Sugar Board, was preliminary and subject to revision after September, a government statement said.

The purchase price set was for cane containing 10 commercial sugar level (CCS). For cane with CCS above or below that level, 30 baht could be added to or deducted from the reference price of 500 baht.
Thailand's sugar cane crushing season starts in November and ends in May or June.
The country expects to crush 60.32 tonne of sugar cane and produce 6.28 million tonnes of sugar tel quel this season.
